# TruckMate Visibility Service API (ART; shipments and stop status for Visibility Hub)

- **Product:** TruckMate Visibility Service API (ART; shipments and stop status for Visibility Hub) (Transportation family).
- **Disposition:** `reference`. The bridge never calls this API; operations can be searched with `trimble_api_operations` and validated into a dry-run plan with `trimble_api_plan` (omit `product`).
- **Authentication:** TruckMate API key (bearer). Declared security schemes: truckmateApiKeyAuth.
- **Access:** TruckMate customers using Visibility Hub (described in the TruckMate 2026.1 release notes).
- **To call it you would need:** a TruckMate API key and the customer's TruckMate ART host (the definition declares no servers); position updates are personal data.
- **Documented servers:** none in the definition.
- **Definition:** [truckmate-visibility](https://truckmatecloudhub.trimble-transportation.com/visibility/openapi.json) (Visibility, version 25). Documentation: https://learn.transportation.trimble.com/wp-content/uploads/tte/am9cye79c1s4oy65d35c/docs/TruckMate2026.1-ReleaseNotes_72386d_rn.pdf.
